name: getSchedules
description: Gets a group's timetable for a given week. Format the answer clearly, grouped by day.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

week.description: ISO week number, e.g. 17. Defaults to the current week.

dept.description: Department, e.g. INFO. Defaults to the user's department.

train_prog.description: Training year, e.g. BUT1. Defaults to the user's training year.

groupe.description: Full group name, e.g. 1A. Defaults to the user's group.
